subject: 2022 Elections and Voter Guide
overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan spoke with Medford City Council Vice President Zac Bears about the upcoming 2022 state primary and general elections. Bears outlined key candidates, state ballot questions, and local budget constraints under Proposition 2 1/2.

items.title: Podcast introduction and social media update
items.summary: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan introduced season three of the podcast and shared social media handles for listener updates.

items.title: Overview of the 2022 election schedule
items.summary: City Council Vice President Zac Bears detailed the schedule for the September primary and November general elections, emphasizing the high impact of Democratic primary races in Massachusetts.

items.title: Statewide and local primary candidates
items.summary: Bears listed candidates running in primary races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, secretary of state, auditor, and state representative seats covering Medford.

items.title: November ballot questions and Fair Share Amendment
items.summary: Bears described the three state ballot questions, detailing how Question 1's Fair Share Amendment would tax income over one million dollars to fund public education and transportation.

items.title: Medford structural deficit and Proposition 2 1/2
items.summary: Bears explained the mechanics of Proposition 2 1/2 and how its tax levy limits contribute to Medford's long-term municipal budget challenges.

items.title: Voting options and primary closing remarks
items.summary: Bears encouraged voters to participate in the primary election and highlighted available voting options, including mail-in and early voting.
